statement: When a parser replaces one that stalled, give its timing guard input shaped against the new parser's own loops, not only the old stall's shape. #521 replaced a quadratic per-line regex with a structural reader of GitHub Actions run steps. Its timing guard used single-line workflows just under the content limit, the shape the old regex choked on. The new reader walked back through the file once per run: key and rescanned every command per requiring command. A 480 KB workflow of 24,000 steps took 12 s under the default rubric, and 24,000 run: keys outside a list took 20 s, against a 2 s budget (src/witan/repo-signals.ts, githubActionsRunSteps at 7db216363). Fix: precomputed indexes and per-job and per-workflow caching, plus a timing guard with many lines and many steps.
